title: Ideal-supported affine sections in powers of an ample pullback
statement: Let f:Y -> X be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], L an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], and M=f^*L its tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Assume M invertible and ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Let J be a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf on Y [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] and y outside its support. There are n>0, a section v of J tensor f^*(L^n), and an affine open V containing y such that V is the nonvanishing locus of the image of v under J -> O_Y tensored with f^*(L^n), followed by the left unitor; V is disjoint from the support of J.

source.place: Lemma 09NX, final paragraph, construction t=t1*t2; Properties Proposition 01Q3 (1)/(6) and Lemma 01PV; monoidal pullback compatibility of Modules 01CD

proof.text: The compactness conjunct of ampleness supplies CompactSpace Y. Apply exists_section_of_ample_ideal to M and J at y to obtain p>0 and a section v1 of J tensor M^p whose image u1 does not vanish at y. Ampleness itself supplies q>0 and a section u2 of M^q with affine nonvanishing open U2 containing y.

Form tmulSection v1 u2 and transport through the associator and M.tensorPowAddIso to J tensor M^(p+q). Naturality of tensorHom and the left unitor identifies its image with the product of u1 and u2 transported to M^(p+q). On simultaneous local generators the two sections have coefficients a,b; the product has coefficient ab. In each residue field ab is nonzero iff a and b are nonzero. Thus its locus is the intersection U2 cap Y_u1 and contains y. affine_cap_section_open applied to M^p and u1 makes this intersection affine.

At a point in the support of J, every local section of J lies in the maximal ideal. Locally trivializing M^(p+q) shows the image section lies in maximal-ideal times its stalk, so its nonvanishing locus avoids the support. The natural monoidal pullback comparison gives f^*(L^(p+q)) isomorphic to M^(p+q). Transport the ideal-tensor section along its inverse, tensored with J. The left unitor and tensorHom are natural, so its image is the transported section. The stalk map of an isomorphism is linear with linear inverse and therefore preserves maximal-ideal times stalk; this keeps the locus unchanged. Finally p+q>0.
